name: pliego
description: Pliego — plataforma editorial digital full stack

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=backend & npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run db:generate --workspace=backend && rm -rf backend/public && cp -R frontend/dist backend/public
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
